products.gapSummary: Four white 200 g/m² variants (A4, A3, A2 and B1) remain without a qualifying complete main. New actual-source files from Quill, Seawhite/Creative Activity, CleverPatch, Peterkin, Winc, Pri Levčku, Satko, Milton and Active Paper fail the native size minimum. Large Folia sources show branded packaging or tightly cropped stack detail. Faltkarten shows cropped watercolor paper rather than the verified sold stock. Buystarget shows clipped stacks, folded cards with a purple cast, or a soft retail pack.

products.gapSummary: All 27 exact 130 g/m² B2 colours remain without qualifying photos. URSUS, Antus and McBuero confirm colour references, but native range/colour images are small, swatches or applications. Buttinette offers native 1321 × 1500 imagery, yet the same irregular edges and marks recur identically in orange, black and yellow with digital colour changes. Racher/Marpa Jansen supplies 49 colour swatches and one range illustration. No accepted colour substitutions or template recolours were made.

evidence.finding: Original Antus130gsm B2 palette maps suffix01 white,13yellow,17intenseyellow,19cornyellow,40orange,23carmine,25darkred,31lightblue,33blue,35California,37skyblue,51lightgreen,53green,55darkgreen,58grassgreen,61darklilac,63violet,72brown,74darkbrown,75lightbrown,81grey,90black. No cross-brand code mapping inferred.
Grafopak GRA/GD2 code42134 has grey reverse and coated white front;350gsm listed450μm caliper. KraftGT4, plain greyboard and generic white cardstock cannot stand in for this named grade.
Manufacturer-linked Grafopak supplier lists350gsm but original industrial sheets71×101/72×102cm, with custom cuts. No photo of verified soldA3/A4 found.
Scene7 req=imageprops establishes native1321×1500. req=props instead reports rendered response size and must not be mistaken for native dimensions.
Root independently decoded three new white A3/200 g/m² source files: Creative Activity 1000 × 1000; Milton 419 × 600; Active Paper 1280 × 720. All fail at least one native axis.
